text: You don't necessarily need a paid subscription. Cash advances are generally available based on eligibility, which depends on things like your linked bank account and income history. Subscription status can affect advance amounts and delivery options, though, such as a fee for faster delivery versus free standard delivery. Because details can change and vary by account, the most accurate answer is in the Albert app. Tap the Instant tab to see your advance amount, delivery options, and any fees before you confirm.
